task_title: Fix Floor 1 seed-33 pistol contact-retreat pin regression

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (gpt-5.4) found no blockers. Three minor deferred concerns, all documented as accepted trade-offs: (1) the 60-active-poll window could release the carve-out sooner in a true pin, deferred because 60 polls bounds worst-case bleed and the headless regression + 50-seed pistol sweep show no resulting deaths; (2) displacement measures movement not escape quality, deferred because it strictly improves on the prior freeze-in-place failure and a stronger heuristic (repeated pickRetreatTarget fallback signal) is called out as a documented follow-up in the PR description; (3) the per-floor latch could couple across two different long-range contact threats on the same floor, deferred as unobserved in practice and narrower scoping (per-threat) was already rejected in the plan for reintroducing eid churn noise in an 18-enemy swarm. No fundamentally better alternative was identified (plan_divergence: minor).

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly fixes the regression by adding robust futility tracking for the contact-retreat carve-out, preventing the AI from freezing when cornered. The implementation elegantly handles edge cases such as brief out-of-contact gaps and positional escapes without relying on wall-clock frame spans. Test coverage is exceptional, introducing both exhaustive unit tests for every behavioral edge case and a deterministic headless test to lock in the seed-33 fix. The code is highly maintainable, thoroughly documented, and strictly follows determinism and scoping rules.
